description: This PHP source file defines a REST API controller class 'SystemCheckAPI' within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends an abstract controller to handle system check requests during the upgrade process, utilizing the 'SystemCheck' utility to perform and return system health assessments.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that provides system check results during the upgrade process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, performs system checks via SystemCheck utility, and returns the check results along with interruption status.
